content.comment_body: Hello, has anyone used [product_name] [version_no]? Has the issue with the hours counter, which only records whole minutes, been resolved? [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: This discussion points out an ongoing problem with the hours counter in [product_name] [version_no], which still records only full minutes instead of providing greater detail. Users are concerned that this issue remains unresolved in the updated release, showing that user requirements are not fully met by the product's current functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the hours counter in [product_name] [version_no] to be improved so that it can measure time more accurately and is not limited to counting only whole minutes.
